novelty.justification: The claim's novelty route is a new mechanistic relationship: a "compact, causally-active 'status direction'" shared across honorific languages that modulates sycophancy and "leaks across languages" into an English answer. Searches using “LLM honorific social status representation activation steering,” “cross-lingual honorific sycophancy,” “Japanese keigo residual stream,” and “prompt politeness multilingual LLM compliance” found the closest work to be When Truth Is Overridden (2025), which mechanistically studies sycophancy and reports that user authority is not internally encoded, alongside Controlling Japanese Honorifics in English-to-Japanese Neural Machine Translation (2019), Do Language Models Understand Honorific Systems in Javanese? (2025), and Cross-Lingual Activation Steering for Multilingual Language Models (2026), none of which connects honorific status representations to epistemic deference and cross-language behavioral leakage. Moving from those works to the proposed shared status axis and its causal coupling to sycophancy requires a new core relationship rather than merely renaming a standard probe or directly transferring it to another language, although it remains within established representation-probing and activation-steering frameworks rather than creating a new paradigm.
